extraction_supporting_text.sample_size: The study included 40 newly diagnosed prostate cancer patients, 22 patients with BPH and 30 healthy male subjects.
extraction_supporting_text.cases: The study included 40 newly diagnosed prostate cancer patients, 22 patients with BPH and 30 healthy male subjects.
extraction_supporting_text.p_value: Mean serum Se, Zn and Mn levels of PCa group were significantly lower as compared to BPH and healthy groups (p < 0.005) (Fig.
